title: Wrong database password after a deploy
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the api component, the config problem (incorrect credentials), and that the deploy introduced the misconfiguration.
root_cause: The api 2.3.2 deploy introduced incorrect PostgreSQL credentials for the "shop" user, causing authentication failures on product API calls.
truth: api 2.3.2 reads the database password from a new setting that was never filled in, so PostgreSQL rejects every login from the api.
